description: UK One Advanced attribute-only companion (xlsx, 11 columns), no prices. 'Specifications' is a pipe-delimited key=value string built from antibody attributes; aliases from target alternate names. Customers exclude the SKUs in coupa_marketplace_excluded_uk.csv.

columns.expression: '|'.join(kv for kv in ['Species Reactivity=' + lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_lsds_antibody_fields.csv', 'reactivity', '').strip(), 'Applications=' + ('' if lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_lsds_antibody_fields.csv', 'applications', '?') == '' else row['assays']), 'Simple Host=' + lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_lsds_antibody_fields.csv', 'host', '').strip(), 'Iso Type=' + lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_lsds_antibody_fields.csv', 'isotype', '').strip(), 'Shipping Conditions=' + row['shipping_conditions'], 'Storage Conditions=' + row['storage_temperature']] if not kv.endswith('='))
